notes: Units: mg/dL = SI × factor (ApoB: g/L × 100). Lp(a) factor is null: store mg/dL and nmol/L as entered, never convert. retestWeeks null = measure once. Rule "when.op >= 0" means "any entered value". "when.sex" and "when.and" extend the A3 schema. Placeholders {value} and {date} are filled from the stored measurement.

ranges.note: ATP III: < 100 optimal, 100–129 near optimal, 130–159 borderline high, 160–189 high, ≥ 190 very high (mg/dL). Printed on most Indian reports.
CSI 2023 goals: < 100 low/moderate risk, < 70 high, < 55 very high and extreme risk (mg/dL).
LAI: < 50 mg/dL for established ASCVD or diabetes with added risk factors; ≤ 30 optional for extreme risk (abstract).
ESC/EAS 2019: < 116 low, < 100 moderate, < 70 high, < 55 very high risk (mg/dL).
ADA 2026: age 40–75 with diabetes < 70; with ASCVD < 55 mg/dL.
EAS/EFLM: non-fasting LDL ≥ 3 mmol/L (≈ 116 mg/dL) is flagged; non-fasting LDL reads ≈ 8 mg/dL lower.

clinicianOnly.message: LDL at or above 190 mg/dL can mean an inherited cholesterol condition. Please see a clinician; Vitals keeps planning but cannot assess this.

ranges.note: ATP III: < 40 low; ≥ 60 high. Metabolic-syndrome criterion < 40 men / < 50 women.
CSI 2023: desirable > 40 men, > 50 women; a risk marker, not a target; raising HDL with drugs not recommended.
EAS/EFLM: ≤ 1 mmol/L (≈ 40 mg/dL) flagged.
CSI 2023 goals: < 130 low/moderate, < 100 high, < 85 very high and extreme risk (mg/dL).
ESC/EAS 2019: goal ≈ LDL goal + 30 mg/dL (exact table not confirmed this session).
EAS/EFLM: ≥ 3.9 mmol/L (≈ 150 mg/dL) flagged.

clinicianOnly.message: Non-HDL at or above 220 mg/dL (LDL 190 + 30) when LDL is not reported. Please see a clinician. Derived threshold.

ranges.note: NCEP: < 150 normal, 150–199 borderline high, 200–499 high, ≥ 500 very high (mg/dL).
Mild 150–199, moderate 200–999, severe 1000–1999, very severe ≥ 2000 mg/dL (categories via S73).
CSI 2023: < 150 desirable; drug therapy considered for fasting TG > 500.
ADA 2026: TG ≥ 500 needs medical therapy (pancreatitis risk).
EAS/EFLM: non-fasting ≥ 2 mmol/L (≈ 175 mg/dL) flagged; non-fasting TG reads ≈ 26 mg/dL higher.

clinicianOnly.message: Triglycerides at or above 500 mg/dL need medical treatment because of pancreatitis risk. Please see a clinician before changing your diet.
Triglycerides at or above 1000 mg/dL are severe. Please contact a clinician soon.

ranges.note: EAS/EFLM: ApoB ≥ 1.0 g/L (100 mg/dL) flagged.
CSI 2023: no universal ApoB target stated.
ESC/EAS 2019 ApoB goals (< 65 / < 80 / < 100 mg/dL by risk, as quoted in the index) NOT confirmed in an opened page.
< 30 mg/dL (< 75 nmol/L) lower risk; > 50 mg/dL (> 125 nmol/L) higher risk. mg/dL ↔ nmol/L conversion is isoform-dependent and not reliable.
CSI 2023: desirable < 50 mg/dL; measure at least once in a lifetime; about 1 in 4 South Asians above 50 mg/dL (> 125 nmol/L).
ESC/EAS 2019: > 180 mg/dL carries risk similar to heterozygous familial hypercholesterolaemia.
ESC/EAS 2025 focused update: > 50 mg/dL (≥ 105 nmol/L) clinically relevant (low confidence: page identity not independently verified).

clinicianOnly.message: Lp(a) at or above 180 mg/dL carries risk similar to inherited high cholesterol. Please discuss it with a clinician.

interactions.effectSize: +0.12 mmol/L (+4.6 mg/dL) vs low-fat at ≥ 12 mo [S5]; +0.16 mmol/L (+6.2 mg/dL) at ≥ 6 mo [S6]. interactions.population: Overweight/obese RCT adults (mean); normal-weight young adults (tail)
interactions.mechanism: More saturated fat lowers hepatic LDL-receptor activity; in lean people, more fat-carrying lipoprotein output (Lipid Energy Model, a hypothesis)

interactions.effectSize: +0.07 mmol/L (+2.7 mg/dL) vs low-fat at 6–12 mo [S12]; LDL fell 3.7 mg/dL less than on low-fat [S14]; −1.0 mg/dL vs usual diet at 6 mo [S13]

interactions.effectSize: −3.3 mg/dL (protein 25 %E vs carbohydrate diet, 6-wk feeding) [S15]; no difference in energy-restricted trials (mean 12 wk) [S16]; not significant across 74 trials [S17]

interactions.effectSize: TRE + CR vs CR alone: +0.5 mg/dL (95 % CI −8.5 to 9.5) at 12 mo [S48]; +1.39 mg/dL (ns) across 6 RCTs [S49]

interactions.effectSize: +23 mg/dL after one 24-h water fast (second-hand figure from S51 table; abstract S50 reports total cholesterol up); pooled fasts ≤ 3 d: Hedges g +0.32

interactions.effectSize: Pooled water-only fasts ≤ 3 d: LDL Hedges g +0.32 (standardised, small-to-moderate) [S51]; no direct 36–48 h trial opened

interactions.effectSize: +0.036 mmol/L (+1.4 mg/dL) per 1 %E SFA replacing carbohydrate; vs PUFA the swap differs by 0.058 mmol/L (2.2 mg/dL) per %E [S1]. Cutting SFA 15 → 6 %E lowered LDL 11 % in 8 wk [S27]. Coconut oil +10.5 mg/dL vs non-tropical oils [S29]
